2.description: This feature vector activates strongly on characters, subwords, and words from the Hindi writing system (Devanagari script).

53.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel signs and consonant-vowel combinations used in word formation.

27.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflectional morphemes.

145.description: This vector is related to character n-grams and common syllables found in the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.

14.description: This feature vector represents character sequences and conjunct consonants from the Devanagari script used for Indic languages.

116.description: This vector activates for dependent vowel signs in Indic scripts alongside unrelated ASCII character fragments due to shared byte-level representations.

4.description: This vector activates common Hindi function words, pronouns, and quantifiers.

162.description: This vector detects fragmented or non-English script subwords, often representing encoding artifacts or rare characters from diverse writing systems.

51.description: This vector activates for the Hindi consonant 'भ' (bha) and its various vowel and conjunct variations.

195.description: This feature vector activates on tokens and sub-word units containing common South Asian and Middle Eastern script fragments, particularly in Hindi and Arabic-Persian-Urdu orthographies.
